sections.text:
- Tool: context7 `resolve-library-id` («Rector PHP») → `/rectorphp/rector`, `/websites/getrector`; `query-docs` · Date: 2026-09-28
- Query 1 (`/rectorphp/rector`): «RenameClassRector configuration: does it rename the namespace of the class declaration file, docblock types, and string class names; importNames withImportNames» → «No documentation … matched this query».
- Query 2 (`/websites/getrector`): «RenameClassRector rename class with namespace change» → only generic custom-rule / `withPaths` snippets (getrector.com/documentation/custom-rule, config-configuration, how-rector-works); nothing on RenameClassRector semantics.
- Outcome: no fact taken from context7; E1 rests on pplx-01 and is VERIFY-AT-EXEC through the mandatory dry run (runbook §4.3 steps 2–4), whose result is independent of whether Rector also rewrites the declaring namespace (the script sets every declaration explicitly).
